item.title: Household loan growth slows as jeonse transactions decline... Individual 'debt investment' increase also narrows (전세거래 줄자 가계대출 증가세 둔화…개인 '빚투' 증가 폭도 줄어)
item.description:
Household loan growth appears to have weakened in July. This is mainly attributed to a decline in jeonse (lease deposit) transactions. (가계 대출 증가세가 7월 들어선 약해진 것으로 나타났다. 주로 전세거래 감소에 따른 영향으로 풀이된다.)

According to the Bank of Korea's "July Financial Market Trends" released on the 14th, the balance of bank household loans at the end of July stood at 1,194.8 trillion won, up 5.4 trillion won from the end of the previous month. This marks a reduction compared to 6.9 trillion won in May and 7.6 trillion won in June. (한국은행이 14일 내놓은 ‘7월 금융시장 동향’을 보면, 7월말 현재 은행 가계대출 잔액은 1194조8천억원으로 전월말보다 5조4천억원 늘었다. 5월 6조9천억원, 6월 7조6천억원에 견줘 증가 폭이 축소됐다.)

Among household loans, the increase in mortgage loans was 3.4 trillion won, less than June's 4.3 trillion won. The Bank of Korea said this was "due to the continued impact of increased housing transactions in the Seoul metropolitan area from April to May, but also because the decline in jeonse transactions continued and the demand for interim payment installments for new housing supply slowed." Jeonse loans decreased by 700 billion won in June and contracted by 800 billion won in July as well. The decline in jeonse loans has been ongoing since September last year. (가계대출 중 주택담보대출 증가 폭은 3조4천억원으로 6월(4조3천억원)보다 적었다. 한은은 “4∼5월 중 수도권 주택거래량 증가의 영향이 지속됐으나, 전세거래 감소세가 이어지고 분양물량의 중도금 납부수요가 둔화된 데 따른 영향”으로 풀이했다. 전세자금대출은 6월 7천억원 줄고, 7월에도 8천억원 축소됐다. 전세자금 대출 감소세는 지난해 9월부터 이어지고 있다.)

Due to the slowdown in individual stock investments, the increase in "other loans" was 2 trillion won, also reduced compared to June's 3.3 trillion won. Other loans, a category of household loans, include general credit loans, credit line loans (overdraft accounts), and commercial real estate-backed loans. Individual net stock purchases dropped sharply from 42.6 trillion won in May and 52 trillion won in June to 3.4 trillion won in July. (개인의 주식투자 둔화 영향으로 ‘기타 대출’ 증가 폭은 2조원으로 이 역시 6월(3조3천억원)에 견줘 축소됐다. 가계대출의 한 갈래인 기타 대출에는 일반 신용대출, 신용한도대출(마이너스 통장), 상업용 부동산 담보대출이 포함돼 있다. 개인 주식 순매수 규모는 5월 42조6천억원, 6월 52조원에서 7월에는 3조4천억원으로 대폭 줄었다.)

The Financial Services Commission announced on the same day that the increase in household loans across the entire financial sector, including banks, was 6.2 trillion won in July, down from 8.3 trillion won the previous month. The increase in mortgage loans fell from 4.5 trillion won in June to 3.5 trillion won in July. The increase in other loans also narrowed from 3.8 trillion won to 2.7 trillion won over the same period. (은행권을 포함한 전체 금융권 가계 대출 증가 폭은 7월 한달 6조2천억원으로 전월(8조3천억원)보다 축소됐다고 금융위원회가 이날 밝혔다. 주택담보대출 증가 폭은 6월 4조5천억원에서 7월 3조5천억원으로 줄었다. 기타 대출 증가 폭도 같은 기간 3조8천억원에서 2조7천억원으로 축소됐다.)

Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Bok-hyun said, "The core of the 'comprehensive financial measures for stabilizing the real estate market' (announced the previous day) is to maintain a consistent demand-management stance while strengthening support for genuine homebuyers," adding, "Care must be taken to ensure that adjustments to the household loan total target are not perceived as a relaxation of lending management, which could stimulate speculative demand." (이억원 금융위원장은 “(전날 발표한) ‘부동산시장 안정을 위한 금융 종합대책’의 핵심은 일관된 수요관리 기조는 유지하되 실수요자 지원을 강화하는 것”이라며 “가계대출 총량목표 조정이 대출관리 기조의 완화로 인식돼 투기적 수요를 자극하지 않도록 유의할 필요가 있다”고 말했다.)

The balance of corporate loans in the banking sector was tallied at 1,421.1 trillion won at the end of July, up 7.7 trillion won from the previous month. While the increase is smaller than May's 10.6 trillion won, it expanded compared to June's 5.1 trillion won. The increase in large corporate loans grew from 3.4 trillion won in June to 3.8 trillion won. This was attributed to continued working capital demand from companies for repaying corporate bonds, as well as the re-booking of temporary repayments from the end of the previous quarter. The Bank of Korea said the increase in SME loans expanded significantly from 1.7 trillion won to 3.9 trillion won over the same period, driven by value-added tax payment demand and aggressive lending by some banks. (은행권의 기업대출 잔액은 7월말 현재 1421조1천억원으로 전월보다 7조7천억원 늘어난 것으로 집계됐다. 증가 폭이 5월(10조6천억원)보다는 적지만, 6월(5조1천억원)에 견줘선 확대됐다. 대기업대출 증가 폭은 6월 3조4천억원에서 3조8천억원으로 커졌다. 회사채 상환을 위한 기업들의 운전자금 수요가 지속되는 가운데 전월 분기말 일시상환분 재취급에 따른 영향으로 분석됐다. 부가가치세 납부 수요, 일부 은행들의 대출 영업 확대로 중소기업 대출 증가 폭은 같은 기간 1조7천억원에서 3조9천억원으로 대폭 확대됐다고 한은은 밝혔다.)

For corporate bonds, repayments exceeded issuances by 1.9 trillion won in July, due to sustained issuance burdens from rising interest rates and seasonal off-peak effects. Net corporate bond redemption has continued for eight consecutive months. Commercial paper (CP) and short-term bonds shifted from net redemption of 1.7 trillion won in June to net issuance of 4 trillion won in July, driven by re-issuance of temporary repayments from the end of the quarter. Equity issuance expanded from 300 billion won in June to 1.5 trillion won in July, partly due to paid-in capital increases by some large corporations. (회사채는 금리 상승에 따른 발행 부담 지속, 계절적 비수기 영향으로 7월 상환액이 발행액보다 1조9천억원 많았다. 회사채 순상환 흐름은 8개월째 이어지고 있다. 기업어음(CP)·단기사채는 분기말 일시상환분 재발행 등으로 6월 순상환(1조7천억원)에서 7월 순발행(4조원)으로 전환됐다. 일부 대기업의 유상증자 등으로 주식 발행 규모는 6월 3천억원에서 7월 1조5천억원으로 확대됐다.)

Kim Young-bae, Senior Reporter kimyb@hani.co.kr (김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Bread, Ramen, and Convenience Food Prices on the Rise... Increases of Up to 9% Amid High Oil Prices and Exchange Rates (빵·라면·간편식 가격 ‘뜀박질’…고유가·고환율에 최대 9%대 올린다)
item.description:
With high oil prices, a strong dollar, and rising costs of raw and subsidiary materials and logistics accumulating over a long period, price increase moves across the food industry are spreading in all directions. From bakeries and confectioneries to ramen and convenience foods, major food companies are successively raising product prices, which is expected to further deepen the burden of grocery bills on consumers. (고유가와 고환율, 원·부재료비 및 물류비 상승이 장기간 누적되면서 식품업계의 가격 인상 움직임이 전방위로 확산하고 있다. 제과제빵부터 라면, 간편식에 이르기까지 주요 식품기업들이 연이어 제품 가격을 올리면서 소비자의 장바구니 물가 부담이 한층 심화할 전망이다.)

Paris Baguette announced on the 14th that it will raise prices on some products in stages starting from the 25th. The items subject to the increase total 127, including 86 types of bread and 41 types of cakes and desserts, with an average increase of 5%. This marks the first price adjustment in a year and a half since February of last year. The premium white bread (Sangmi-jong) will rise by 5.1% (from 3,900 won to 4,100 won), and castella cake by 4.2% (from 2,400 won to 2,500 won). The "My Number One" cake will go up by 2.9% (from 35,000 won to 36,000 won). A Paris Baguette official explained, "This is an unavoidable measure due to rising raw material costs and various other expenses." (파리바게뜨는 오는 25일부터 차례대로 일부 제품 가격을 인상한다고 14일 밝혔다. 인상 품목은 빵류 86종, 케이크와 디저트 41종 등 총 127종으로 평균 인상 폭은 5%다. 지난해 2월 이후 1년6개월 만의 가격 조정이다. 상미종 생식빵은 5.1%(3900원→4100원), 카스테라는 4.2%(2400원→2500원) 오른다. 마이 넘버원 케이크는 2.9%(3만5000원→3만6000원) 상향 조정된다. 파리바게뜨 관계자는 “원료비와 제반 비용 상승에 따른 불가피한 조처”라고 설명했다.)

Earlier, Tous les Jours also raised the recommended consumer prices of 76 items, including the Daily Milk Bread, by an average of 8.2% starting from the 31st of last month. SPL (Samilip) is also set to increase the prices of around 50 bread products by an average of 9% starting from the 1st of next month. (앞서 뚜레쥬르도 지난달 31일부터 데일리우유식빵 등 76종의 권장소비자가격을 평균 8.2% 인상했으며, 삼립 역시 다음달 1일부터 빵 제품 50여 종의 가격을 평균 9%대 올릴 예정이다.)

Noodle and snack prices are also being raised one after another. Ottogi will raise the factory prices of 29 cup ramen items and 16 dumpling items by an average of 6.7% and 7.7%, respectively, based on large supermarket prices, starting from the 7th of next month. Accordingly, based on large supermarket prices, the spicy Jin Ramen cup and Yeul Ramen cup are expected to rise from 1,200 won to 1,300 won, and the Sesame Ramen cup from 1,400 won to 1,550 won. However, all bag-type ramen products were excluded from the increase. Nongshim also raised factory prices starting from the 1st of this month, by an average of 6.0% for 18 cup noodle brands, including Yukgaejang bowl noodles, by an average of 5.5% for 23 snack brands, including Shrimp Chips, and by an average of 7.7% for beverage products. (면류와 스낵류 가격도 줄줄이 인상된다. 오뚜기는 다음 달 7일부터 대형마트 기준 컵라면 29개 품목과 만두 16개 품목의 출고가를 각각 평균 6.7%, 7.7% 올린다. 이에 따라 대형마트 기준 진라면 매운맛 용기와 열라면 용기는 1200원에서 1300원으로, 참깨라면 용기는 1400원에서 1550원으로 가격이 오를 것으로 예상된다. 다만 봉지라면 전 품목은 인상 대상에서 제외됐다. 농심 역시 지난 1일부터 육개장사발면 등 용기면 18개 브랜드는 평균 6.0%, 새우깡 등 스낵 23개 브랜드는 평균 5.5%, 음료 제품은 평균 7.7% 출고가를 인상했다.)

Price adjustments in the frozen food and convenience food sectors are also continuing. Pulmuone raised consumer prices of 30 items, including hot dogs, dumplings, and naengmyeon, by an average of 6.7% starting from the 13th. The representative product, Mozzarella Hot Dog (4-pack), went up from 8,480 won to 8,980 won, and the "Yalpi Kkwak-chan" dumplings from 9,980 won to 10,480 won. Considering the burden on consumers' basic food expenses, ingredients such as tofu and namul were excluded. Earlier, CJ CheilJedang also raised prices of 27 items, including Hatbahn rice (12%), dumplings (4.6%), and grilled fish (8.4%), by an average of 8% starting from the 30th of last month. (냉동식품·간편식 업계의 가격 조정도 잇따르고 있다. 풀무원은 지난 13일부터 핫도그, 만두, 냉면 등 30개 품목의 소비자가격을 평균 6.7% 올렸다. 대표 제품인 모짜렐라 핫도그(4입)는 8480원에서 8980원으로, 얄피꽉찬 만두는 9980원에서 1만480원으로 인상됐다. 소비자의 기본 먹거리 부담을 고려해 두부·나물 등 식자재는 제외했다. 앞서 씨제이(CJ)제일제당도 지난달 30일부터 햇반(12%), 만두(4.6%), 생선구이(8.4%) 등 27개 품목의 가격을 평균 8% 인상한 바 있다.)

An industry official said, "With costs of imported raw materials, packaging materials, sea freight, and fuel all soaring, we are in a situation where we can no longer postpone price adjustments." (업계 관계자는 “수입 원재료 부담과 포장재 가격, 해상운임 및 유류비 등 제반 생산 원가가 급등해 가격 조정을 더 이상 미룰 수 없는 상황”이라고 말했다.)

Lee Ju-bin Reporter yes@hani.co.kr (이주빈 기자 yes@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Corporate earnings boom leads to surge in money supply... fueling inflation (기업 실적 호조에 통화량 급증...물가 상승 이어져)
item.description:
Money supply expansion driven by strong corporate earnings is continuing. The increase in money supply is cited as a key factor stimulating price rises. (기업 실적 호조에 따른 통화 팽창이 이어지고 있다. 통화량 증가는 물가 상승을 자극하는 주요인으로 꼽힌다.)

According to the "June Money and Liquidity" data released by the Bank of Korea on the 14th, the average balance of broad money (M2) in June stood at 4,213 trillion won, up 29.4 trillion won (0.7%) from the previous month. While the month-on-month increase was smaller than May's 32.2 trillion won (0.8%), it is still assessed as a relatively large expansion. On a year-on-year basis, it grew 6.0% (237 trillion won), recording the highest growth rate since February 2023 (6.2%). (한국은행이 14일 발표한 ‘6월 통화 및 유동성’을 보면, 6월 광의통화(M2) 평잔은 4213조원으로 전월대비 29조4천억원(0.7%) 늘어난 것으로 집계됐다. 전월대비 증가 폭이 5월 32조2천억원(0.8%)보다는 작지만 비교적 큰 폭의 증가세로 평가된다. 전년동월 대비로는 6.0%(237조원) 증가해 2023년 2월(6.2%) 이후 최대 증가율로 기록됐다.)

Broad money, a wide-ranging measure of money supply, includes cash, demand deposits, and instant-access savings deposits (all part of M1), as well as short-term financial instruments that can be quickly converted to cash, such as money market funds (MMFs), time deposits and installment savings with maturities under two years, certificates of deposit (CDs), repurchase agreements (RPs), financial bonds with maturities under two years, and money trusts with maturities under two years. (넓은 의미의 통화량 지표인 광의통화에는 현금, 요구불예금, 수시입출금식 예금(이상 M1) 외에 머니마켓펀드(MMF), 2년 미만 정기 예·적금, 양도성예금증서(CD), 환매조건부채권(RP), 2년 미만 금융채, 2년 미만 금전신탁 등 곧바로 현금화할 수 있는 단기 금융상품이 포함된다.)

The increase in money supply appears to stem from robust earnings at export-oriented large corporations, particularly in the semiconductor sector. The Bank of Korea explained, "By category, the expansion of short-term surplus funds management by non-financial corporations led to an increase in money market funds (MMFs), and corporate holdings of time deposits and installment savings with maturities under two years rose sharply, contributing to the growth in money supply." The increase in MMFs widened from 2.5 trillion won in May to 7.3 trillion won in June, while time deposits and installment savings under two years swung from a decrease of 4.7 trillion won in May to an increase of 7.1 trillion won in June. (통화량 증가는 반도체 부문을 중심으로 한 수출 대기업들의 실적 호조에서 비롯된 것으로 보인다. 한은은 “상품별로 볼 때 비금융기업의 단기여유자금 운용 확대로 머니마켓펀드(MMF)가 증가하고 2년 미만 정기예적금의 기업 보유분이 대폭 늘어나면서 통화량 증가로 이어졌다”고 설명했다. 머니마켓펀드 증가 폭은 5월 2조5천억원에서 6월 7조3천억원으로 확대됐고, 2년 미만 정기예적금은 5월 4조7천억원 감소에서 6월에는 7조1천억원 증가로 전환됐다.)

By sector, broad money increased for non-financial corporations (45.7 trillion won) and other financial institutions (5.4 trillion won), but decreased for households and non-profit organizations (-19.8 trillion won) and other sectors (social security institutions and local governments, -1.1 trillion won). The decline in household broad money is interpreted as stemming from personal funds moving into stock investments. Broad money calculated under the old criteria, which includes beneficiary certificates, rose 1.2% from the previous month and 12.3% from a year earlier, reflecting this shift. The average balance of narrow money (M1) stood at 1,402.9 trillion won, up 0.4% from the previous month and 10.0% from a year earlier. (주체별 광의통화량을 보면 비금융기업(45조7천억원), 기타 금융기관(5조4천억원) 쪽에선 증가한 반면, 가계 및 비영리단체(-19조8천억원), 기타부문(사회보장기구 및 지방정부·-1조1천억원)은 감소했다. 가계부문의 광의통화 감소는 개인 자금이 주식투자 쪽으로 이동한 데서 비롯된 것으로 풀이된다. 수익증권을 포함하는 옛 기준 광의통화량이 전월 및 전년 동월대비 각각 1.2%, 12.3% 늘어난 게 이를 반영한다. 협의통화(M1) 평잔은 1402조9천억원으로 전월대비 0.4%, 전년 동월대비 10.0% 늘어난 것으로 집계됐다.)

Kim Young-bae, Senior Reporter kimyb@hani.co.kr (김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Homeplus Workers Receive 77.8 Billion Won in Support Including Loans… Government Says "Support Will Continue" (홈플러스 노동자에 융자 포함 778억 지원됐다…정부 “지원 계속”)
item.description:
It has been confirmed that approximately 77.8 billion won has been provided so far to Homeplus workers amid the ongoing corporate rehabilitation process, including unemployment benefits and loans. (기업회생 절차가 진행 중인 홈플러스 노동자에 대해 현재까지 실업급여, 융자금 등으로 약 778억원이 지원된 것으로 확인됐다.)

The Ministry of Economy and Finance announced on the 14th that it held a meeting of the government task force (TF) involving related agencies at the Seoul Government Complex to review the status of Homeplus's business resumption and the support provided to workers and partner companies. (재정경제부는 14일 정부서울청사에서 홈플러스 관련 관계기관 전담반(TF) 회의를 열고 홈플러스 영업 재개 상황과 노동자·협력업체 지원실적을 점검했다고 밝혔다.)

According to the review results, since the court's commencement of rehabilitation procedures (March 4, 2025 – August 12, 2026), workers have received 35.9 billion won in unemployment benefits and substitute payments, 41.2 billion won in loans for living expenses due to wage arrears, and 700 million won in loans for livelihood stabilization. For partner companies, 11.6 billion won in emergency management stabilization funds was supplied through the Small Enterprise and Market Service and the Korea Venture Investment Corporation, while the banking sector provided 5.4 trillion won in maturity extensions and repayment deferrals, as well as 30.9 billion won in new emergency loans. The Korea Credit Guarantee Fund and the Korea Technology Finance Corporation also provided guarantees worth 48.4 billion won to partner companies. (점검 결과 법원의 회생절차 개시 이후(2025년 3월4일~2026년 8월12일) 노동자들에게 실업급여·대지급금 359억원, 임금체불 생계비 융자 412억원, 생활안정자금 융자 7억원 등이 지원된 것으로 집계됐다. 협력업체에는 소상공인시장진흥공단·중소벤처기업진흥공단 긴급경영안정자금 116억원이 공급됐고, 은행권에서는 만기연장·상환유예 5조4천억원 및 신규긴급자금대출 309억원 등을 제공했다. 신용보증기금과 기술보증기금도 협력업체에 484억원 규모의 보증을 협력업체에 지원했다.)

Last month, Homeplus secured 200 billion won in emergency operating funds from Meritz Financial, which it used to prepare for operations, including paying overdue wages and settling product payments, and formally resumed operations at 67 stores starting on the 13th. It must demonstrate its ability to generate profits over the approximately three weeks remaining until next month's 9th, the final deadline for the court's approval of the rehabilitation plan. (홈플러스는 지난달 메리츠금융으로부터 2천억원 규모의 긴급운영자금을 조달한 뒤 체불임금 지급 및 상품 대금 결제 등 영업 준비에 활용했으며, 지난 13일부터 67개 점포에서 영업을 정식 재개했다. 법원 회생 계획안 가결 최종 기한인 다음달 9일까지 약 3주 동안 수익 창출 능력을 입증해야 한다.)

The Ministry of Economy and Finance stated, "We will continue to closely monitor Homeplus's business trends while continuing to provide sufficient support to ensure the livelihood and business stability of workers and partner companies." (재경부는 “앞으로도 홈플러스 영업 동향을 지속 모니터링하는 한편, 근로자·협력업체의 생계·경영 안정 등을 위한 충분한 지원을 계속해 나가겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Dongduk Women's University Hosts 'WA! Well-Aging Art Garden Blooming Together' – A Senior Cultural Sharing Festival (동덕여대, ‘WA! 함께 피어나는 웰에이징 아트마당’ 개최…시니어 문화나눔 축제)
item.description:
Dongduk Women's University (President Lim Se-jin) ANCHOR Project Team held the 'WA! Well-Aging Art Garden Blooming Together' event on July 30 at the on-campus small theater, connecting senior lifelong education programs with cultural activities and social participation. 'WA' stands for 'Well-aging Arts,' carrying the meaning of a 'well-aging cultural community' as well as an invitation to 'come together' and share art and life. (동덕여자대학교(총장 임세진) ANCHOR 사업단은 지난 7월 30일 교내 소극장에서 시니어 평생교육 프로그램을 문화활동·사회참여로 연결짓는 ‘WA! 함께 피어나는 웰에이징 아트마당’을 개최했다. ‘WA’는 ‘Well-aging Arts’의 약자로, '웰에이징 문화공동체'의 의미와 더불어 ‘함께 와서’ 예술과 삶을 나누자는 초대의 뜻을 담고 있다.)

The event served as a venue for exchange where graduates of the 1st and 2nd cohorts of the Dongduk ANCHOR Senior Well-Aging Academy and local senior art teams shared their experiences and talents. As the implementing institution of Seoul's 'Regional Growth Talent Development System (ANCHOR)' project, Dongduk Women's University operates senior lifelong education programs that combine the university's expertise with the foundations of local institutions. Participants have learned dance therapy and expressive arts counseling to care for their minds and bodies, and have developed artistic experiences into meaningful relationships. (행사는 동덕 ANCHOR 시니어 웰에이징 아카데미 1·2기 수료생과 지역 시니어 예술팀이 서로의 경험과 재능을 나누는 교류의 장으로 진행됐다. 동덕여대는 서울시 '지역성장 인재양성체계(앵커·ANCHOR)' 사업의 수행기관으로서, 대학의 전문성과 지역기관의 기반을 결합한 시니어 평생교육 과정을 운영하고 있다. 수강생들은 댄스테라피와 표현예술상담 등을 배우며 몸과 마음을 돌보고, 예술적 경험을 관계 형성으로 발전시켜왔다.)

At this event, academy participants and local senior art teams showcased a variety of artistic activities, including creative movement based on dance therapy, line dance, ocarina, and theater. Participatory programs involving the audience were also prepared. The event was praised for highlighting seniors not merely as beneficiaries or spectators of culture and the arts, but as cultural protagonists. Alongside Dongduk Women's University, the Seongbuk 50 Plus Center, the Art Life Dasom Association, and the Green Harmonia Art Performance Team also took part. (이번 행사에서 아카데미 참여자와 지역 시니어 예술팀은 댄스테라피 기반의 창작 움직임을 비롯해 라인댄스, 오카리나, 연극 등 다양한 예술 활동을 선보였다. 관객이 함께하는 참여형 프로그램도 마련됐다. 시니어를 문화예술의 수혜자나 관람객에 머무르는 존재가 아니라 문화의 주체로 조명했다는 평이다. 동덕여대를 중심으로 성북50플러스센터, 사단법인 아트라이프 다솜, 그린하모니아트 공연단 등이 함께했다.)

Professor Yoon Hye-sun of Dongduk Women's University's College of Performing Arts, who oversaw the event's planning, said, "This was a platform showing that learning does not end with completion but can extend into community cultural activities," adding, "I hope the virtuous cycle of seniors sharing their experiences and talents as cultural protagonists, beyond being beneficiaries of art, continues to spread." (행사를 총괄 기획한 윤혜선 동덕여대 공연예술대학 교수는 “배움이 수료로 끝나는 것이 아니라 지역사회 문화활동으로 이어질 수 있음을 보여준 자리”라며 “시니어가 예술의 수혜자를 넘어 문화 주체로서  경험과 재능을 나누는 선순환이 확산되기를 기대한다”고 말했다.)

Dongduk Women's University plans to further develop the university–community win-win well-aging cultural model in the future. (동덕여대는 앞으로도 대학–지역사회 상생형 웰에이징 문화 모델을 더욱 발전시켜 나갈 계획이다.)

item.title: Sahmyook University Graduate School Counseling Psychology Alumni Donate 10 Million Won to Alma Mater (삼육대 대학원 상담심리학과 동문들, 모교에 발전기금 1천만원 쾌척)
item.description:
Master's and doctoral alumni of the Counseling Psychology Department at Sahmyook University's Graduate School donated 10 million won to their alma mater. Twenty-four alumni each contributed a modest amount to join the '120th Anniversary Touching Donation Relay.' (삼육대 대학원 상담심리학과 석·박사 동문들이 모교에 발전기금 1천만원을 기부했다. 동문 24명이 십시일반으로 뜻을 모아 '개교 120주년 감동 기부 릴레이'에 동참했다.)

Dr. Im Young-ok, who participated in the donation, explained the background, saying, "The grace we received from our professors during our time as students was immense. Beyond teaching us knowledge, they showed us an example of what it means to be a true counselor, which left a deep impression on us. With the hope of being of some help to the development of the department and the university, the alumni willingly came together." (기부에 참여한 임영옥 박사는 "재학 시절 교수님들께 받은 은혜가 무척 컸고, 지식을 가르쳐 주시는 것을 넘어 참된 상담가로서의 본보기를 보여주신 스승의 모습에 깊은 감명을 받았다"며 "학과와 모교 발전에 조금이나마 힘이 되었으면 하는 마음으로 동문들이 흔쾌히 뜻을 모았다"고 기부 배경을 설명했다.)

These alumni had previously donated 13 million won to the university's development fund in 2023. Dr. Im added, "I hope the joy of sharing, practiced with a grateful and happy heart, will lead to more alumni joining in the future." (이들 동문은 앞선 지난 2023년에도 대학 발전기금 1천3백만원을 기부한 바 있다. 임 박사는 "감사하고 행복한 마음으로 실천한 나눔의 기쁨이 앞으로 더 많은 동문의 동참으로 이어지길 기대한다"고 덧붙였다.)

President Je Hae-jong stated, "The alumni of the Counseling Psychology Department have set an exemplary precedent through their continued giving. We deeply appreciate their willingness to take the lead in the university's development in celebration of the 120th anniversary." (제해종 총장은 “상담심리학과 동문들이 지속적인 나눔으로 모범적인 선례를 만들어 주셨다”며 “개교 120주년을 기념해 모교 발전에 흔쾌히 앞장서주신 것에 깊이 감사드린다”고 말했다.)

To mark its 120th anniversary this year, Sahmyook University is actively carrying out a 'Touching Donation Relay' to build a solid foundation for the university's new leap and development. (삼육대는 올해 개교 120주년을 맞아 '감동 기부 릴레이'를 활발히 전개하며 대학의 새로운 도약과 발전을 위한 든든한 발판을 마련하고 있다.)

item.title: Private School Teachers' Pension Service Holds Ulchi Exercise Preparation Briefing and Reviews Emergency Readiness (사학연금, 을지연습 준비보고회의 개최 및 비상대비태세 점검)
item.description:
The Private School Teachers' Pension Service (Chairman Song Ha-jung, hereinafter referred to as the PPS) announced on the 14th that it is making thorough preparations for the "2026 Ulchi Exercise," which will be held from the 18th to the 21st to establish emergency readiness. (사립학교교직원연금공단(이사장 송하중, 이하 사학연금)은 18일부터 21일까지 비상대비태세 확립을 위해 실시되는“2026년 을지연습”준비에 만전을 기하고 있다고 14일 밝혔다.)

The PPS stated that ahead of the Ulchi Exercise, it has promoted various activities to raise security awareness among employees and local residents and to establish a state of emergency preparedness. (사학연금은 을지연습을 앞두고 임직원과 지역주민의 안보의식을 높이고 비상대비태세를 확립하기 위한 다양한 활동을 추진했다고 밝혔다.)

On the 7th, a visit was held for employees to the Naju·Gwangju Student Independence Movement Memorial Hall to conduct a security awareness event. Through this event, employees had time to reflect on the historical significance of the Student Independence Movement and share the importance of national security. (지난 7일 임직원 대상으로 나주·광주학생독립운동기념관을 방문해 안보의식 고취행사를 실시했다. 이번 행사를 통해 임직원들은 학생독립운동의 역사적 의미를 되새기고 국가안보의 중요성을 공유하는 시간을 가졌다.)

Then, on the 11th, the PPS visited the Bitgaram Dream Growth Center in Naju City and carried out promotional activities to inform local students and parents about the Ulchi Exercise. The organization operated a security word quiz and an emergency supplies exhibition to generate interest in the Ulchi Exercise, allowing participants to directly examine related items and experience the importance of emergency preparedness. This public-participatory promotional activity, designed with programs tailored to the level of students and parents, served as an opportunity to enhance understanding of the Ulchi Exercise and raise security awareness in daily life. (이어 11일에는 나주시 빛가람꿈자람센터를 찾아 지역 학생과 학부모를 대상으로 을지연습을 알리는 홍보활동을 펼쳤다. 공단은 안보 낱말퀴즈와 비상물자 전시를 운영해 을지연습에 대한 관심을 유도하고, 참가자들이 관련 물품을 직접 살펴보며 비상대비의 중요성을 체감하도록 했다. 이번 국민참여형 홍보활동은 학생과 학부모의 눈높이에 맞춘 프로그램으로 을지연습에 대한 이해를 높이고, 일상 속 안보의식을 제고하는 계기가 됐다.)

In particular, on the 13th, a preparatory briefing meeting for the Ulchi Exercise chaired by the head of the institution was held to comprehensively review the preparation status and key implementation matters by sector. At this meeting, the overall exercise plan was carefully examined to ensure that the institution's response system could operate without disruption in the event of an actual emergency, rather than remaining a mere formal exercise. (특히 13일에는 기관장 주재 을지연습 준비보고회의를 개최해 분야별 준비상황과 주요 추진사항을 종합적으로 점검했다. 이번 회의에서는 형식적인 연습에 그치지 않고 실제 비상상황 발생시 기관의 대응체계가 차질없이 작동할 수 있도록 연습계획 전반을 면밀히 검토했다.)

PPS Chairman Song Ha-jung stated, "I hope that through this exercise, we can strengthen our practical crisis response capabilities in preparation for national emergencies and create an opportunity to respond swiftly and systematically in the event of a real emergency." (사학연금 송하중 이사장은 “이번 연습을 통해 국가 비상사태를 대비한 실질적 위기대응 역량을 강화하고 실제 비상상황 발생 시 신속하고 체계적으로 대응할 수 있는 기회가 되길 바란다”고 말했다.”)

item.title: Financial chief who vowed to "sever ties between real estate and finance" joins housing minister in "financial support" four months later (“부동산-금융 절연” 외친 금융수장, 넉 달 지나자 국토장관과 “금융 지원”)
item.description:
"Chairman, when you previously announced lending regulations, you made a strong statement about 'severing ties between real estate and finance.' It's a bit ironic to see the two of you side by side now." (“위원장님께서 과거 대출 규제를 발표할 때 ‘부동산과 금융을 절연시키겠다’는 강한 발언을 하신 적이 있습니다. 두 분이 지금 나란히 계신 게 조금 아이러니하긴 한데요.”)

That was a comment from a reporter at the briefing on "Measures for the Rapid Supply of Housing to Stabilize the Jeonse, Monthly Rent, and Sales Markets" held on the morning of the 13th. That day, the government announced plans to supply an additional 230,000 or more housing units in the Seoul metropolitan area, along with supporting financial measures. With Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yun-deok and Financial Services Commission (FSC) Chairman Lee Bok-hyun seated side by side, the reporter pointed out the gap between the measures announced that day—expanding the household loan total volume management target from 1.5% to 3.0% and easing some lending regulations—and the earlier slogan of "severing ties between real estate and finance." <<> The phrase "severing ties between real estate and finance" first appeared on April 1. On that day, Chairman Lee announced the "2026 Household Debt Management Plan" and stressed, "To escape the stigma of being a ruinous real estate republic, a bold severance between the real estate market and finance is urgently needed." In a parliamentary briefing to the National Assembly's Political Affairs Committee on the 29th of last month, he also stated, "Severing ties between real estate finance is my conviction." However, looking solely at the household loan total volume target, it appears the government has stepped back from its high-intensity management stance within just four months. <<> When asked at the briefing the previous day whether the earlier severance stance had been retreated from, Chairman Lee responded, "The severance of real estate and finance means correcting the parts where finance flows abnormally and unproductively due to speculative demand or excessive concentration of funds into real estate." He explained that it was not about blocking real estate finance altogether but about curbing only the funds flowing toward speculative demand. <<> The "rise in nominal GDP growth" that Chairman Lee cited as the basis for raising the household loan total volume target also contradicts the FSC's explanation from just a month earlier. At the briefing, Chairman Lee said, "Many circumstances have changed compared to when the initial household debt total growth target was set" and "There's a part where the nominal GDP growth itself has risen significantly." The point is that, driven by the semiconductor boom and other factors, nominal gross domestic product (GDP) is growing rapidly, so even if household loans increase by 3%, the household debt-to-GDP ratio can still be managed stably. <<> However, at the FSC's briefing on second-half work plans on the 15th of last month, FSC Secretary General Shin Jin-chang drew a line when asked whether the total volume target could be eased to reflect the rise in nominal GDP growth, saying, "We are not considering it at this point." Secretary General Shin said at the time, "It's just that the size of economic growth has grown; it's not that the household debt size has shrunk" and added, "The average household debt-to-GDP ratio in advanced countries is in the mid-60% range, but ours is in the high-80% range." This was an explanation that even if the household debt ratio decreased, the absolute size of household debt and its risks had not diminished. <<> Secretary General Shin also provided reasons for maintaining the total volume target. He said, "If we ease the household debt management stance under current circumstances, there is concern it could stimulate the real estate market" and noted, "Even under the 1.5% management target, policy loans for ordinary people and other programs are largely exempt." The logic was that expanding the total volume could stimulate real estate demand, and since some loans requiring greater protection were already exempt, there was no need to increase lending capacity further. Just one month ago, the rise in nominal GDP growth was not considered sufficient grounds to raise the target—now it has become the basis for doubling it. <<> A day after announcing the raising of the household loan total volume target, on the 14th, FSC Chairman Lee Bok-hyun stressed at an expanded household debt review meeting that "this adjustment must not become a signal that stimulates speculative lending demand." The government's remarks reflect an awareness of the risk that the expansion of the total volume could be read as a signal of regulatory easing. <<> Experts believe these concerns are already materializing in the market. Professor Jeong Jun-ho of Kangwon National University (real estate studies) said, "In the market, there is a strong tendency to interpret this measure as a signal that finance has been loosened rather than as an expansion of supply" and added, "If households with spare funds outside of loans—such as from inheritances, gifts, or conglomerate bonuses—also gain additional borrowing capacity, moves to more desirable neighborhoods could occur sequentially, centered on existing homeowners." Within the limits allowed by individual regulations such as the debt service ratio (DSR) and loan-to-value (LTV) ratio, loans are possible, but borrowers who could not obtain loans due to financial institutions' total volume shortfalls now have greater room to borrow as well, which could increase demand for purchasing homes or upgrading and heighten upward pressure on housing prices. <<> Ahn Tae-ho Reporter eco@hani.co.kr (지난 13일 오전 열린 ‘전월세 및 매매시장 안정을 위한 주택 신속공급 방안’ 브리핑에서 한 취재진이 꺼낸 말이다. 이날은 정부가 수도권에 23만호 이상을 추가로 공급하고, 이를 뒷받침할 금융지원 방안을 발표하는 자리였다. 김윤덕 국토교통부 장관과 이억원 금융위원장이 나란히 앉은 가운데, 이날 가계대출 총량관리 목표를 1.5%에서 3.0%로 확대하고 일부 대출 규제를 완화한 이번 대책과 ‘부동산·금융 절연’이라는 기존 구호 사이의 간극을 꼬집은 것이다.)

item.title: Trump's '2 US Warships Built in Allied Nations' Has Geoje Cheering?… Let's Examine the Actual Feasibility (트럼프 “미 군함 2척 동맹국서 건조”에 거제 야호?…실제 가능성 따져보니)
item.description:
Will US Navy warship construction become a reality in Geoje, South Gyeongsang Province, and Ulsan? (경남 거제, 울산에서 미국 해군 군함 건조가 현실이 될까.)

As President Donald Trump signed a presidential memorandum on the 13th (local time) allowing foreign shipbuilders that have invested in the US to build up to two US military vessels at their home-country shipyards, analyses are emerging that the possibility of US warship construction in South Korea—which proposed the 'MASGA' (Make American Shipbuilding Great Again) project—has grown. However, evaluations suggest that whether Trump's memorandum can circumvent US laws prohibiting foreign construction of combat vessels and congressional opposition remains to be seen. (도널드 트럼프 대통령이 13일(현지시각) 미국에 투자한 외국 조선업체가 본국 조선소에서 최대 두 척의 미군 함정을 건조할 수 있도록 하는 대통령 각서에 서명하면서, ‘마스가’(MASGA·미국 조선업을 다시 위대하게) 프로젝트를 제안한 한국에서 미 군함 건조 가능성이 커졌다는 분석이 나온다. 다만 전투함의 외국 건조를 금지하는 미국법과 의회 반발을 트럼프 각서가 우회할 수 있을지는 좀 더 지켜봐야 한다는 평가다.)

① Layers of Laws Prohibiting Foreign Construction of US Combat Vessels (① 미 전투함 외국 건조 금지법 ‘겹겹’ )

The US principally prohibits the foreign construction of US military vessels to protect its domestic shipbuilding industry and for national security reasons. The institutional barriers preventing foreign construction are multiple. The 'National Defense Authorization Act' (NDAA), the highest-level law in the defense sector, is the biggest obstacle. In December of last year, the US Congress stipulated in this year's NDAA that 'an exception is made to allow construction at shipyards located outside the US only for up to two non-combat support vessels for missile defense testing, not warships.' The NDAA is enacted annually. The Trump administration proposed legislation to allow the construction of two combat vessels and two non-combat auxiliary vessels at foreign shipyards to induce foreign investment in US shipyards. However, the next fiscal year's NDAA bill, which passed the US House of Representatives last month, also includes a provision stating that 'Navy funds may not be used for combat ships (Battle Ship) constructed at foreign shipyards.' The US Navy defines combat vessels as including both warships and combat support auxiliary vessels. This is the result of opposition from lawmakers with shipyards in their districts who cite job protection, technology leakage, and protection of the shipbuilding industry as reasons against overseas construction of military vessels. (미국은 자국 조선산업 보호와 국가안보 등을 위해 미 군함의 외국 건조를 원칙적으로 금지하고 있다. 외국 건조를 막는 제도적 장치는 여러 겹이다. 국방 분야 최상위법인 ‘국방수권법’이 가장 큰 걸림돌이다. 지난해 12월 미 의회는 올해 국방수권법에 ‘군함이 아닌 미사일 방어 시험을 위한 비전투 지원선 최대 2척에 한해서만 예외적으로 미국 외 국가에 위치한 조선소 건조를 허용한다’고 명시했다. 국방수권법은 해마다 제정된다. 트럼프 행정부는 자국 조선소로의 외국 투자를 유도하기 위해 외국 조선소에서 전투함 2척과 비전투 보조함 2척을 건조할 수 있도록 하는 입법 제안을 했다. 그러나 지난달 미 연방 하원을 통과한 내년도 국방수권법안에도 ‘해군 예산을 외국 조선소에서 건조되는 전투함(Battle Ship)에 쓰지 못한다’는 내용이 담겼다. 미 해군은 전투함을 군함 외에 전투 보조 지원함까지 포함하는 개념으로 정의한다. 지역구에 조선소를 둔 의원들이 일자리 보호, 기술 유출, 조선산업 보호 등을 이유로 군함 해외 건조에 반대한 결과다.)

Additionally, the 'Department of Defense Appropriations Act,' which pertains to the use of US Department of Defense (DoD) budget, also prohibits the construction of US Navy vessels at foreign shipyards. The 'Byrnes-Tollefson Act' prohibits the construction of ships and components for the US military at foreign shipyards, although the President does have authority to grant exceptions. (여기에 미 전쟁부(국방부) 예산 사용과 관련한 ‘국방부 세출법’도 미 해군 군함의 외국 조선소 건조를 금지한다. ‘번스-톨레프슨법’의 경우 대통령의 예외 적용 권한이 있긴 하지만, 미군을 위한 선박과 구성품의 외국 조선소 건조를 금지하고 있다.)

② Trump Seeking a Breakthrough via the 'Finland Model' (② 트럼프 ‘핀란드 모델’로 돌파구 찾기)

According to the 'America's Maritime Industrial Base' report released by the White House in February this year, only 6 of the 66 shipyards in the US are capable of constructing large vessels over 400 feet (122 meters) in length. A shortage of skilled labor was cited as a major problem. Earlier, at the Group of Seven (G7) summit held in Évian, France in June, President Trump reportedly asked President Lee Jae-myung, 'Can you build 10 US warships quickly?' President Lee reportedly replied, 'Of course it's possible, and we will do our best.' (올해 2월 백악관이 공개한 ‘미국 해양 실행계획’ 보고서를 보면, 미국 전체 66개 조선소 가운데 400피트(122m) 이상 대형 선박 건조가 가능한 조선소는 단 6곳뿐이다. 숙련 노동자 부족 등이 주요 문제점으로 지적됐다. 앞서 6월 프랑스 에비앙에서 열린 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 때 트럼프 대통령은 이재명 대통령에게 ‘미국 군함 10척을 빠르게 건조해 줄 수 있겠느냐’고 물었을 정도다. 이 대통령은 “당연히 가능하고 최선을 다하겠다”고 답했다고 한다.)

To address this serious backlog in warship construction, the White House has been considering ways to circumvent the NDAA and other laws prohibiting foreign warship construction, despite congressional opposition. Trump's presidential memorandum issued that day appears to seek a breakthrough in the 'Finland Model.' In the memorandum's explanatory materials, the White House stated, "This memorandum directs the Department of Defense to pursue more direct investment in the American shipbuilding industrial base based on the 'Finland model,' which was first introduced and proved successful in the Coast Guard's medium polar icebreaker program." (백악관은 이런 심각한 군함 건조 적체 상황을 해결하기 위해 미 의회 반대에도 군함의 외국 건조를 금지한 국방수권법 등의 우회로를 고민해왔다. 이날 나온 트럼프의 대통령 각서는 ‘핀란드 모델’에서 돌파구를 찾는 것으로 보인다. 백악관은 대통령 각서 설명자료에서 “이번 각서는 해안경비대의 중형 쇄빙선 프로그램에 처음 도입돼 성공을 거둔 ‘핀란드 모델’(Finland model)을 기반으로 미국 조선산업 기반에 대한 보다 직접적인 투자를 추진할 것을 전쟁부(국방부)에 지시한다”고 설명했다.)

At the end of last year, President Trump invoked his 'domestic construction special waiver' authority, citing national security. This allowed the US Coast Guard to commission Finland, which possesses world-class technology, to build 11 icebreakers for use on Arctic routes. The initial four vessels are to be built in Finland, with the remaining seven to be built in the US based on Finnish design and construction technology. (트럼프 대통령은 지난해 말 국가안보를 이유로 ‘국내 건조 특별 면제 조치’ 권한을 발동했다. 미 해안경비대가 북극항로에서 사용할 쇄빙선 11척을 세계 최고 기술력을 가진 핀란드에 건조를 맡기기로 한 것이다. 초기 4척은 핀란드 현지에서 건조하고, 7척은 핀란드 설계와 건조 기술을 바탕으로 미국에서 건조하는 방식이다.)

The Trump memorandum signed on the 13th is intended to extend this model to Navy combat vessels. The plan is to build the initial batch of new combat vessels at shipyards in allied nations like South Korea, and then build subsequent vessels at US production facilities backed by investments from those allied nations, thereby cultivating shipbuilding industry manpower and technology in the US. The draft DoD budget for the next fiscal year already includes funds to investigate the cruiser, destroyer, and frigate construction capabilities of allied nation shipyards. (13일 서명한 트럼프 각서는 이를 해군 전투함으로도 확대 적용하겠다는 의도다. 신규 전투함 초기 물량을 한국 등 동맹국 조선소에서 건조한 뒤, 이후 물량은 해당 동맹국 투자를 받아 미국 내 생산시설에서 건조해 조선산업 인력과 기술을 키우겠다는 것이다. 내년도 전쟁부 예산안에는 동맹국 조선소의 순양함·구축함·호위함 건조 능력을 조사하기 위한 예산이 반영된 상태다.)

③ What are the Chances for Hanwha Ocean and HD Hyundai Heavy Industries? (③ 한화오션·HD현대중공업 건조 가능성은?)

In the explanatory materials for the presidential memorandum, the White House stated that if a foreign shipbuilder satisfies all four of the following conditions—△constructing a new shipyard in the US or acquiring ownership or a majority stake in an existing US shipyard; △employing and training American workers; △transferring shipbuilding technology and methods held by their home-country shipyards to US shipyards; and △establishing a supply chain for construction and maintenance within the US—they will be "temporarily permitted to construct up to two vessels at their home-country shipyard." It explained this is a temporary measure to fill short-term capability gaps, and that all subsequent vessels must be built at shipyards within the US. (백악관은 대통령 각서 설명자료에서 외국 조선업체가 △미국에 새 조선소를 건설하거나 기존 미국 조선소의 소유권 또는 과반 지분 확보 △미국인 노동자 고용·훈련 △본국 조선소가 보유한 조선 기술과 기법을 미국 조선소에 이전 △미국 내 건조·정비를 위한 공급망 구축 등 4가지 조건을 모두 충족한 경우, “해당 조선업체 본국 조선소에서 최대 두 척의 선박을 건조하도록 한시적으로 허용한다”고 밝혔다. 이는 단기적 전력 공백을 메우기 위한 한시 조처이며, 이후 선박은 모두 미국 내 조선소에서 건조해야 한다고 설명했다.)

Currently, the domestic shipbuilder meeting all these conditions is Hanwha Ocean (Geoje Shipyard). Hanwha Ocean acquired a 100% stake in Philadelphia's Philly Shipyard in the US in 2024, which became a foundation for promoting the 'MASGA' project under the Lee Jae-myung administration. It has signed joint design contracts with Leidos Gibbs & Cox, a US warship design expert, and has also established cooperation agreements for shipbuilding technology education and development with Philly Shipyard and Delaware County Community College. It has also signed shipbuilding supply chain cooperation agreements with the Philadelphia Chamber of Commerce and others. The Hanwha Group recently also revealed its proposal to acquire the US business of Australian shipbuilder Austal. (현재 이런 조건을 모두 충족한 국내 조선업체는 한화오션(거제조선소)이다. 한화오션은 2024년 미 필라델피아 필리조선소 지분 100%를 인수했고, 이는 이재명 정부 들어 ‘마스가’ 프로젝트를 추진하는 발판이 됐다. 미 함정 설계 전문업체 레이도스 깁스 앤 콕스와 공동 설계 계약 등을 맺었고, 한화필리조선소와 델라웨어 카운티 커뮤니티 칼리지와 조선 기술 교육·개발 협력도 체결했다. 또 필라델피아 상공회의소 등과 조선산업 공급망 협력도 체결했다. 한화그룹은 최근 오스트레일리아 조선 방산업체 오스탈의 미국 사업 인수 제안 사실을 밝히기도 했다.)

HD Hyundai Heavy Industries (Ulsan Shipyard) currently meets the remaining conditions but hasn't yet invested in a US shipyard. It provides production automation systems to Huntington Ingalls, the largest US defense shipbuilder, while also promoting shipbuilding talent development with the University of Michigan and others, and conducting local supply chain cooperation with US defense firm Fairbanks Morse Defense. An HD Hyundai official stated, "We are currently reviewing and discussing the acquisition of or equity investment in a US local shipyard." (HD현대중공업(울산조선소)은 미국 조선소 투자 외 나머지 조건을 충족한 상태다. 미 최대 방산 조선사인 헌팅턴 잉걸스에 생산자동화 시스템 등을 제공하는 한편, 미시간대 등과 함께 조선 인재 양성 추진, 미 방산업체 페어뱅크스 모스 디펜스와 현지 공급망 협력을 진행하고 있다. HD현대 쪽은 “현재 미국 현지 조선소 인수 및 지분 투자를 위한 검토와 협의를 진행하고 있다”고 밝혔다.)

Last month, the 'Korea-US Shipbuilding Cooperation Center' opened in Washington, DC. Jointly participated in by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, Hanwha Ocean, HD Hyundai Heavy Industries, and Samsung Heavy Industries, it will serve as a forward base for the MASGA project, covering △US ship construction △Maintenance, Repair, and Operations (MRO) △shipbuilding workforce development, and △technology and supply chain cooperation. (지난달에는 미국 워싱턴에 ‘한미 조선협력센터’가 문을 열었다. 산업통상부와 한화오션·HD현대중공업·삼성중공업이 공동 참여해, △미국 선박 건조 △유지·보수·정비(MRO) △조선 인력 양성 △기술·공급망 협력 등 마스가 프로젝트의 전초 기지 구실을 하게 된다.)

However, whether the Finland model emphasized by President Trump can overcome US laws prohibiting foreign warship construction, congressional opposition, and resistance from the US shipbuilding industry remains uncertain. This is because there is no precedent for entrusting the construction of core security assets like Navy cruisers, destroyers, and frigates—beyond the Coast Guard's 'icebreaker' level—to foreign nations. (다만 트럼프 대통령이 강조한 핀란드 모델이 군함의 외국 건조를 금지하는 미국법과 의회 반발, 미 조선업계 반대를 넘어설 수 있을지는 미지수다. 해안경비대의 ‘쇄빙선’ 수준을 넘어선 해군 순양함·구축함·호위함 등 핵심 안보자산 건조를 외국에 맡긴 전례가 없기 때문이다.)

Nevertheless, the White House has made its determination to push through clear. In the explanatory materials, the White House directly criticized the state of its own shipbuilding industry, stating, "The US Navy has faced repeated warship construction setbacks due to overly complex designs and repeated design changes. This has led to cost overruns, construction delays, and cancellations." It particularly emphasized the urgency of resolving the warship order backlog, citing that "a massive order backlog has developed across six major naval shipbuilding programs due to a lack of capacity and competition," in order to prevent capability gaps. (그럼에도 백악관은 돌파 의지를 분명히 했다. 백악관은 설명자료에서 “미 해군은 지나치게 복잡한 설계와 반복적인 설계 변경으로 인해 여러 차례 군함 건조 차질을 빚었다. 이는 비용 증가, 건조 지연과 취소로 이어졌다”고 자국 조선산업 현실을 직격했다. 특히 “역량과 경쟁 부족으로 인해 6개의 주요 해군 조선 프로그램 전반에 걸쳐 대규모 주문 적체가 발생했다”며 전력 공백을 막기 위한 군함 주문 적체 해소의 시급함을 거듭 강조했다.)

The domestic shipbuilding industry predicts that specific prospects will only become clear early next year when the US federal budget plan and the Department of Defense's detailed execution plans are finalized. A defense industry official said, "The key will be whether the presidential memorandum can circumvent higher-level laws like the NDAA." (우리 조선업계에서는 미 연방정부 예산 계획과 전쟁부 세부 실행계획 등이 확정되는 내년 초가 돼야 구체적 전망이 가능할 것으로 내다봤다. 방산업계 관계자는 “상위법인 국방수권법 등을 대통령 각서로 우회할 수 있을지가 관건”이라고 했다.)

Kim Nam-il Reporter namfic@hani.co.kr (김남일 기자 namfic@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Is 'Sell Korea' over? Foreign investors net buy for fourth straight day, KOSPI recovers 7,000 level intraday (‘셀 코리아’ 끝났나…외국인 나흘 연속 순매수, 코스피 장중 7천선 회복)
item.description:
With the KOSPI trending upward and gaining momentum this week, foreign investors have posted net purchases for four consecutive sessions, and optimism is beginning to emerge both inside and outside the market that the 'sell Korea' trend may be over. (이번주 코스피가 우상향을 그리며 상승 탄력을 받은 가운데 외국인 투자자가 나흘 연속 순매수에 나서며, ‘셀코리아’가 끝난 것이 아니냐는 낙관론이 시장 안팎에서 나오기 시작했다.)

On the 14th, the KOSPI closed at 6,977.94, up 2.42% from the previous day. Early in the session, the index surpassed the 7,000 mark and briefly climbed to 7,010.86. The KOSPI had fallen below the 7,000 threshold on a closing basis on the 24th of last month and had struggled to recover it since. On this day as well, the index trimmed its intraday gains and failed to close above 7,000. Still, the KOSPI has shown a steady upward trend throughout this week. On the 10th, the KOSPI rose 0.65% from the previous day to begin its rebound, then gained 0.73% the next day, followed by advances of 2–3%, climbing about 11.5% over five trading sessions. (14일 코스피는 전날보다 2.42% 오른 6977.94로 마감했다. 이날 코스피는 장이 시작된 직후 7천선을 넘어서며 한때 7010.86까지 올랐다. 코스피는 종가 기준으로 지난달 24일 7천선 밑으로 떨어진 뒤 좀처럼 이를 회복하지 못했다. 이날 역시 장중 오름폭을 줄이더니 종가로는 7천선을 넘지 못했다. 다만 코스피는 이번주 내내 완만한 상승세를 보이고 있다. 지난 10일 코스피는 전날보다 0.65% 오르며 반등을 시작하더니 이튿날 0.73%, 그 이후 2∼3% 오르며 5거래일 동안 11.5%가량 뛰었다.)

The driving force behind this sustained rally was foreign investors. This week, foreign investors recorded net purchases for four straight sessions, excluding the 10th (net selling of 1.5 trillion won). Cumulative net purchases from the 11th to the 14th alone reached 8 trillion won. Foreign investors had net bought 8.6 trillion won on the 30th–31st of last month, but that streak lasted only two days, and although they posted net buys for four consecutive sessions from the 20th to the 23rd of last month, the scale was around 5.6 trillion won. The intensity and persistence of foreign net buying this week are analyzed as the highest level seen this year. Since the middle to late part of last month, there has been a gradual inflow of foreign capital. On a monthly basis, this month has recorded net purchases of 600 billion won, the first time since April (1.2 trillion won net buying). After that, foreign investors recorded unprecedented cumulative net selling of 44.5 trillion won in May, 48.4 trillion won in June, and 9.9 trillion won in July. (이를 지속해서 이끈 것은 외국인 투자자였다. 이번주 외국인은 지난 10일(1조5천억원 순매도)을 빼고는 나흘 내내 순매수를 기록했다. 11∼14일 누적 순매수 금액만 8조원에 이른다. 외국인은 지난달 30∼31일 8조6천억원을 순매수했지만 이틀 연속에 그쳤고, 지난달 20∼23일 나흘 연속 순매수한 적도 있지만, 규모는 5조6천억원 정도였다. 이번주 외국인의 순매수 강도와 지속성은 올해 들어 가장 높은 수준으로 분석된다. 지난달 중후반부터 외국인 자금이 서서히 수급되는 듯한 흐름이다. 월별로도 이달 6천억원 순매수를 기록했는데, 지난 4월(1조2천억원 순매수) 이후 처음이다. 이후 외국인은 5월 44조5천억원, 6월 48조4천억원, 7월 9조9천억원이라는 역대급 누적 순매도를 기록했다.)

During this week's four-day foreign buying streak, large-cap semiconductor stocks were the most heavily purchased. Samsung Electronics saw net buying of 3.3 trillion won, and SK Hynix saw 2.9 trillion won. On this day, Samsung Electronics closed at 274,500 won, up 2.43% from the previous day, while SK Hynix finished at 1.645 million won, up 3.26%, continuing their consecutive gains from the 11th to the 14th. Lee Jae-won, a researcher at Yuanta Securities, commented, "With easing U.S. inflation pressure and expectations for artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure investment aligning, foreign capital flowed into large-cap semiconductor stocks, driving a strong KOSPI rally," adding, "Ultimately, today once again confirmed that robust foreign demand is the engine behind the KOSPI rebound." (이번주 외국인이 나흘 연속 순매수하는 동안 가장 많이 사들인 것은 반도체 대형주였다. 삼성전자를 3조3천억원, 에스케이(SK)하이닉스는 2조9천억원 순매수했다. 이날 삼성전자는 전날보다 2.43% 오른 27만4500원, 에스케이하이닉스는 3.26% 오른 164만5000원에 거래를 마치며 역시 지난 11∼14일 연속 상승세를 이어갔다. 이재원 유안타증권 연구원은 “미국 물가 부담 완화와 인공지능(AI) 인프라 투자 기대가 맞물리며 반도체 대형주 중심으로 외국인 자금이 유입돼 코스피가 강하게 상승했다”며 “결국 외국인의 강한 수급이 코스피 반등의 동력임을 오늘도 재확인했다”고 평가했다.)

However, some analysts note that this rally differs from the sharp surge in the first half of this year, as it is not led solely by large-cap semiconductor stocks but rather sees momentum spreading across other sectors. On this day, 677 stocks rose (204 fell) on the KOSPI market, with sectors such as telecommunications, autos, and oil broadly supporting the index. Hyundai Motor and Hyundai Mobis rose 8.24% and 7.05%, respectively, exceeding the gains of large-cap semiconductor stocks, while LG Electronics, Samsung SDI, Hanwha Ocean, and SK Innovation surged 4–5%. SK Telecom soared 10.32%. (다만 이번 상승장은 반도체 대형주가 독주해 이끌지 않고, 여타의 업종으로 열기가 분산된다는 점에서 올해 상반기 급등장과는 다르다는 분석이 나온다. 이날 유가증권시장에서는 677종목이 상승(204종목 하락)하며 통신·자동차·석유 등 업종 전반이 지수를 뒷받침했다. 이날 현대차와 현대모비스는 전날보다 각각 8.24%, 7.05% 오르며 반도체 대형주의 오름폭을 상회했고, 엘지(LG)전자와 삼성에스디아이(SDI), 한화오션, 에스케이(SK)이노베이션은 4∼5% 급등했다. 에스케이(SK)텔레콤은 10.32% 폭등했다.)

The KOSDAQ index closed at 864.65, up 0.38% from the previous day, continuing its upward trend throughout the week like the KOSPI. Heo Jae-hwan, a researcher at Eugene Investment & Securities, interpreted the situation, saying, "The pattern of a strong KOSPI and a firm KOSDAQ is continuing," and "This is a signal that risk appetite has expanded amid simultaneous relief over earnings and inflation." (코스닥 지수는 전날보다 0.38% 오른 864.65에 거래를 마치며 코스피와 마찬가지로 이번주 내내 상승장을 이어갔다. 허재환 유진투자증권 연구원은 “코스피 강세와 코스닥 강보합 구도가 이어지고 있다”며 “실적·물가 동반 안도에 위험 선호가 확대됐다는 신호”라고 풀이했다.)

Kim Ga-yoon, Reporter gayoon@hani.co.kr (김가윤 기자 gayoon@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Land Minister: "Reviewing Housing Supply Across Entire Yongsan Park, Including Children's Garden" (국토장관 “용산공원 전체 주택 공급 검토…어린이정원 포함”)
item.description:
Land Minister Kim Yoon-deok said, "My judgment is that we must keep all possibilities open and review building public housing on suitable sites within Yongsan Park, including the Yongsan Children's Garden." (김윤덕 국토교통부 장관이 “용산어린이정원을 포함해 용산공원 내 적정한 부지에 공공주택을 짓는 방안에 대해 모든 가능성을 열어놓고 검토해봐야 한다는 게 제 판단”이라고 밝혔다.)

Minister Kim made these remarks on the 14th during a press conference marking his first year in office held at the Sejong Government Complex, regarding follow-up supply measures to the "8·13 Rapid Housing Supply Plan" announced the previous day. (김 장관은 14일 세종정부청사에서 열린 취임 1년 기자간담회에서 전날 발표한 ‘8·13 주택 신속공급 방안’의 후속 공급 대책과 관련해 이같이 말했다,)

In the housing supply measures announced on the 13th, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport publicly designated three new candidate sites for residential development—the development-restricted area around Wabu-eup, Namyangju (21,700 housing units), Yeomchang Park in Gangseo-gu, Seoul (1,000 housing units), and the Gyeonggi Gwangju station area (4,500 housing units)—while stating its plan to announce an additional 73,000 housing units' worth of development-restricted areas within the year. (국토부는 13일 발표한 주택 공급 대책에서 남양주시 와부읍 일대 개발제한구역(2만1700호), 서울 강서구 염창공원(1천호), 경기 광주역세권(4500호) 등 3곳을 신규 택지 후보지역으로 공개하면서 연내 7만3천호 규모의 개발제한구역 등을 추가로 발표하겠다는 방침을 밝힌 바 있다.)

Minister Kim said, "The new residential sites for the additional 73,000 housing units to be announced are at the stage where pre-administrative procedures for public review are nearing completion," adding, "The Yongsan Children's Garden is not included in that, but it is a site that could be additionally reviewed, and I think it would be good to review other sites within Yongsan Park as well." He also added that the 73,000-housing-unit sites could potentially be announced as early as late September to early October. (김 장관은 “추가로 공개할 7만3천호 물량의 신규 택지는 주민 공람을 위한 사전 행정 절차가 마무리 단계인 곳들”이라며 “용산어린이정원은 여기에 포함되지는 않고 추가로 검토해볼 수 있는 곳인데, 용산공원 내 다른 부지도 함께 검토하는 게 좋겠다는 생각”이라고 말했다. 또 7만3천호 택지에 대해선 이르면 9월말~10월 초에 발표할 수도 있을 것으로 생각한다고 덧붙였다.)

The Children's Garden, part of the returned land from the U.S. Army's Yongsan base, is a park spanning 300,000 square meters, and if housing were to be built there, it is estimated that between 4,000 and 5,000 units could be possible. The presidential office and the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport are known to be considering a plan to build public rental housing on part of the returned sites, including this area and the U.S. ambassador's residence, to serve as a housing ladder for young people and newlyweds. However, the Seoul Metropolitan Government opposes housing construction within Yongsan Park, citing green space protection and local complaints. (미군 용산기지 반환부지의 일부인 어린이정원은 30만㎡ 규모의 공원으로, 주택을 지을 경우 4천~5천호 규모가 가능할 것으로 추정된다. 청와대와 국토부는 이곳과 미대사관 숙소 등 반환 부지 일부에 공공 임대주택을 지어 청년과 신혼부부 등의 주거사다리 용도로 활용하는 방안을 구상하고 있는 것으로 알려졌다. 그러나 서울시는 녹지 보호와 지역 민원 등을 이유로 용산공원 내 주택 건설에 반대하고 있다.)

Regarding innovation measures for the Korea Land and Housing Corporation (LH), Minister Kim stated they will be announced in September as scheduled. Plans are being reviewed to separate the organization into a dedicated housing supply body and other areas of responsibility such as housing welfare and land reserves, while strengthening functions. (김 장관은 한국토지주택공사(LH) 혁신 방안과 관련해서는 예정대로 9월께 발표할 것이라고 밝혔다. 주택 공급 전담 조직과 기타 주거복지·토지비축 등 담당 영역으로 조직을 분리하고 기능을 강화하는 방안이 검토되고 있다.)

Regarding the second relocation of public institutions, he explained that, barring special circumstances, relocation to innovation cities will be the principle, and that the relocation will be pursued through an "agglomeration and concentration" approach to bring in anchor companies and research institutions together and create synergy effects. Furthermore, in accordance with the president's directive to "challenge zero institutions remaining in Seoul barring special circumstances," he stated that not only public institutions but also administrative agencies are being reviewed for relocation, and that relocating as many institutions as possible is the principle. (공공기관 2차 이전과 관련해서는 특별한 사정이 없으면 혁신도시로의 이전을 원칙으로 하고, 공공기관 이전을 통해 앵커기업과 연구기관 등을 함께 유치해 시너지 효과를 낼 수 있도록 ‘집적과 집중’ 방식으로 추진하겠다고 설명했다. 아울러 ‘특별한 사정이 없는 한 서울에 남는 건 제로(0)에 도전하라’는 대통령 지시에 따라 공공기관뿐 아니라 행정기관도 이전 대상으로 검토하고, 가능한 모든 기관을 이전하는 것이 원칙이라고 밝혔다.)

Senior Reporter Choi Jong-hoon cjhoon@hani.co.kr (최종훈 선임기자 cjhoon@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Strengthening SMR Cooperation"...Bill Gates in Successive Meetings with Ministry of Industry, SK, HD Hyundai, and Doosan (“SMR 협력 강화”…빌 게이츠-산업부·SK·HD현대·두산 연쇄 회동)
item.description:
In conjunction with Bill Gates' visit to Korea—co-founder and board chairman of TerraPower, a next-generation small modular reactor (SMR) development company—the government and domestic companies have moved to strengthen cooperation. SMRs, along with renewable energy, are cited as a key means to address the surging electricity demand driven by artificial intelligence (AI) data centers and other factors. (차세대 소형모듈원자로(SMR) 개발 기업 테라파워 공동창업자이자 이사회 의장인 빌 게이츠 방한에 맞춰, 정부와 국내 기업들이 협력 강화에 나섰다. SMR은 재생에너지와 함께 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터 등에 따른 전력 수요 급증에 대응하는 주요 수단으로 꼽힌다.)

The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy announced on the 14th that Minister Ahn Duk-geun met with Chairman Bill Gates in Seoul that afternoon to discuss ways to expand Korean companies' participation in SMR projects. TerraPower is advancing a fourth-generation SMR project (345MW scale) in Kemmerer, Wyoming, USA, which uses sodium as a coolant. Instead of water, it employs liquid metallic sodium as the coolant. Among SMRs, it is highly regarded for its stability and technological maturity. Having received a construction permit from the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission in March this year, construction is underway with a target for commercial operation in 2031. (산업통상부는 14일 오후 김정관 장관과 빌 게이츠 의장이 서울에서 만나 SMR 사업에 한국기업 참여 확대 방안 등을 논의했다고 밝혔다. 테라파워는 미국 와이오밍주 캐머러에 소듐(나트륨)을 사용한 4세대 SMR 사업(345MW 규모)을 추진하고 있다. 물 대신 액체 상태의 금속 나트륨(소듐)을 냉각재로 사용한다. SMR 가운데서도 안정성과 기술 완성도가 높다는 평가를 받는다. 올해 3월 미국 원자력규제위원회로부터 건설 허가를 받아, 2031년 상업운전을 목표로 건설을 진행 중이다.)

SK Group and HD Hyundai, among others, have already established strategic agreements with TerraPower, including financial investment and supply of key components. During the meeting that day, Minister Ahn emphasized, "To achieve 'standardized SMR deployment' for securing economic viability, combining TerraPower's standard design with Korea's highly reliable mass-production supply chain is essential. Korea, through over 50 years of domestic and overseas nuclear power plant construction and operation, has built a foundry-grade nuclear manufacturing and construction ecosystem and is the optimal partner." The ministry also reported that Minister Ahn explained Korea's advanced nuclear supply chain ecosystem comprising large enterprises and small- and medium-sized companies, and stressed that "Korea could become TerraPower's production hub and Korean companies could be its core supply chain." (이미 SK그룹과 HD현대 등은 테라파워에 대한 재무적 투자와 핵심 부품 납품 등의 전략적 협약 관계를 맺어왔다. 이날 면담에서 김 장관은 “SMR의 경제성 확보를 위한 ‘SMR 표준화 보급’을 위해서는 테라파워의 표준설계와 한국의 신뢰성 높은 대량 양산 공급망의 결합이 필수적이다. 한국은 50여년간 국내외 원전 건설·운영을 통해 파운드리급 원전 제조·건설 생태계를 구축한 최적의 파트너”라고 강조했다고 산업부는 전했다. 김 장관은 또 대기업과 중소·중견기업들로 구성된 고도화한 한국 원전 공급망 생태계를 설명하며 “한국이 테라파워의 생산거점이 되고 한국 기업들이 핵심 공급망이 될 수 있다”는 점을 당부했다고 한다.)

Following the meeting, with Minister Ahn, Chairman Bill Gates, and SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won in attendance, TerraPower and SK Innovation signed a 'Heads of Agreement for a Global Joint Business Development Contract.' The agreement outlines SK Innovation's role in securing opportunities to participate in SMR projects in the U.S. and overseas markets. (면담 뒤 김 장관과 빌 게이츠 의장, 최태원 SK그룹 회장이 참석한 가운데, 테라파워와 SK이노베이션의 ‘글로벌 공동사업 추진계약을 위한 주요 조건 합의서’ 체결이 이뤄졌다. SK이노베이션이 미국과 해외시장에서 SMR 사업 참여 기회를 마련하는 내용이다.)

That day, HD Hyundai Chairman Chung Ki-sun also met with Chairman Bill Gates and TerraPower CEO Chris Levesque. In May of this year, HD Hyundai, TerraPower, and Hyundai Engineering & Construction had signed a 'Three-Party Memorandum of Understanding for Cooperation on Next-Generation Sodium Reactor Projects.' HD Hyundai stated, "Chairman Chung held in-depth discussions on multifaceted cooperation measures for the commercialization of land-based reactors." (이날 정기선 HD현대 회장도 빌 게이츠 의장과 크리스 르베크 테라파워 최고경영자를 만났다. 올해 5월 HD현대, 테라파워, 현대건설은 ‘차세대 나트륨 원자로 사업 협력을 위한 3자 업무협약’을 체결한 바 있다. HD현대는 “정 회장이 육상 원자로의 상용화를 위한 다각도의 협력 방안을 심도 있게 논의했다”고 전했다.)

Doosan Enerbility also announced that day that it had won orders for the fabrication of key SMR equipment for TerraPower, including the reactor protection vessel, reactor support structures, and reactor internals. The company had signed a manufacturability review contract with TerraPower for key equipment in December 2024. Kim Jong-doo, President of Doosan Enerbility's Nuclear Business Group (BG), said, "We will carry out this project without a hitch while continuously strengthening our SMR manufacturing capabilities to expand our role as a global supplier." (두산에너빌리티도 이날 테라파워의 SMR 핵심 기자재인 원자로 보호용기, 원자로 지지구조물, 원자로 내부구조물 제작 사업을 수주했다고 밝혔다. 이 회사는 2024년 12월 테라파워와 핵심 기자재에 대한 제작성 검토 계약을 체결한 바 있다. 김종두 두산에너빌리티 원자력사업부문(BG) 사장은 “이번 프로젝트를 차질 없이 수행하는 한편, SMR 제조 역량을 지속 강화해 글로벌 공급 기업으로서 역할을 확대하겠다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, on the 12th, the government announced at a 'Report Meeting on Seven Future Growth Engine Seeds (SEED)' that it would focus on fostering SMRs alongside nuclear fusion, renewable energy, quantum technology, space and aerospace, advanced biotechnology, and advanced supply chains. The plan includes commercializing light-water SMRs by 2035 and commencing construction of non-light-water SMRs in the 2030s. (한편 정부는 12일 ‘미래성장동력 7대 씨앗(SEED) 보고회’에서 SMR을 핵융합, 재생에너지, 양자, 우주·항공, 첨단바이오, 첨단 공급망 등과 함께 집중 육성하겠다고 밝혔다. 경수형 SMR은 2035년 상용화하고, 비경수형 SMR은 2030년대 건설에 착수한다는 계획이다.)

item.title: Motif Tops Global AI Evaluation?…How Much Should We Trust the 'AAII Score' (모티프, 글로벌 AI 평가서 1위?…‘AAII 점수’ 어디까지 믿어야 하나)
item.description:
Ahead of the second evaluation of the government's 'Sovereign Artificial Intelligence (AI) Foundation Model' (Sovereign Model) project, Motif Technologies (Motif) has made headlines by topping a global AI performance evaluation, beating out major corporations such as LG AI Research and SK Telecom. The reason is that the startup scored higher despite having a parameter size that is less than half that of the conglomerates' models. How did Motif, with its relatively smaller model, manage to surpass the corporate models? <<> According to the 'Intelligence Index' (AAII) by Artificial Analysis, a global AI performance evaluation organization, on the 14th, 'Motif 3' developed by Motif recorded 47 points, the highest among the four companies participating in the Sovereign Model project. Upstage's 'Solar Open 2 250B' followed with 37 points, while SK Telecom's 'A.X K2' and LG AI Research's 'K-EXAONE 2.0' recorded 35 points and 31 points, respectively. <<> What is interesting is that model size did not necessarily correlate with evaluation scores. LG AI Research's K-EXAONE 2.0, which ranked fourth, has a total of 750 billion parameters (37 billion activated during inference), whereas Motif 3, which ranked first, has a much smaller total of 314 billion parameters (13 billion activated). <<> In response, industry insiders point out that it is difficult to simply compare the performance of the two models based solely on the Intelligence Index score. The Intelligence Index evaluates models across nine individual benchmarks—covering agent capabilities, coding skills, long-context comprehension, and scientific and mathematical reasoning—and then aggregates these into a single score. While it is a useful metric for gauging various capabilities of an AI model, it does not measure performance across all areas, so it cannot be viewed as an absolute performance indicator. <<> An industry official explained, "Because Artificial Analysis calculates scores based on nine benchmarks, the results can vary depending on which areas a model has strengths in." <<> In particular, although the Intelligence Index does not disclose the actual test questions, it does publicly reveal the types of questions in advance. This raises the possibility that startups with limited resources, rather than improving a model's various capabilities evenly, may have strategically focused training resources on specific areas such as coding to boost their scores. Choi Byung-ho, a research professor at Korea University's Human-Inspired AI Research Institute, said, "The fact that Chinese startup Moonshot AI's 'Kimi K-3,' with a parameter count of less than 3 trillion, scores similarly to models from OpenAI and Anthropic, which are known to have around 10 trillion parameters, is part of the same context." <<> Ultimately, while the latest Intelligence Index results demonstrate the potential of domestic startups, experts generally agree that this should not be overinterpreted as 'startup models outperforming conglomerates.' Lee Seung-hyun, an adjunct professor at Gachon University's Startup College, said, "Motif achieving notable results with a model of 300 billion parameters is an encouraging demonstration of the capabilities of domestic startups," but added, "It would be a stretch to conclude from this result alone that its overall technology is superior to that of conglomerate models, which have relatively abundant resources and data." <<> Seon Dam-eun Reporter sun@hani.co.kr (정부의 ‘독자 인공지능(AI) 파운데이션 모델’(독파모) 프로젝트 2차 평가를 앞두고, 모티프테크놀로지스(모티프)가 엘지(LG) 에이아이연구원과 에스케이(SK)텔레콤 등 대기업을 제치고 글로벌 인공지능 성능 평가에서 1위를 차지해 화제다. 스타트업이 대기업 모델의 절반 수준에도 못 미치는 매개변수(파라미터) 규모로 더 높은 점수를 받았기 때문인데, 모델 체급이 상대적으로 작은 모티프는 어떻게 대기업 모델을 앞설 수 있었을까.)

item.title: H1 Average Salary: SK Hynix 140 Million Won, Samsung Electronics 63 Million Won (상반기 평균급여 하이닉스 1억4천만원, 삼성전자 6300만원)
item.description:
SK Hynix employees' average salary for the first half of this year exceeded 140 million won. Samsung Electronics employees' average salary was 63 million won. Samsung Electronics did not disclose the average salaries separately for its semiconductor (DS) division and its finished products (DX) division, which handles mobile and home appliances. (에스케이(SK)하이닉스 직원들의 올해 상반기 평균 급여액이 1억4천만원을 넘어선 것으로 나타났다. 삼성전자 직원들의 평균 급여액은 6300만원이었다. 삼성전자는 반도체(DS)부문과 모바일·가전 등을 담당하는 완제품(DX) 부문의 평균 급여액을 구분해 공시하지 않았다.)

SK Hynix disclosed in its semi-annual report on the 14th that the average salary per person for its 36,150 total employees was 144 million won. This is an increase of 27 million won from the first half of last year (117 million won). (에스케이하이닉스는 14일 반기보고서에서 전체 직원 3만6150명의 1인당 평균 급여액이 1억4400만원이라고 공시했다. 지난해 상반기(1억1700만원)보다 2700만원 늘었다.)

CEO Kwak Noh-jung received 26.095 billion won this year. This includes a first-half salary of 1.25 billion won, a bonus of 20.455 billion won, gains from exercising stock options of 4.379 billion won, and other earned income of 1 million won. (곽노정 대표이사 사장은 올해 260억9500만원을 받았다. 상반기 급여 12억5천만원, 상여 204억5500만원, 주식매수선택권 행사이익 43억7900만원, 기타 근로소득 100만원 등이다.)

Samsung Electronics also announced in its semi-annual report on the same day that the average salary per person for its 125,890 total employees was 63 million won. This is an increase of 3 million won from the first half of last year (60 million won). This figure combines both the DS and DX divisions. (삼성전자도 이날 반기보고서를 통해 전체 직원 12만5890명의 1인당 평균 급여액이 6300만원이라고 밝혔다. 지난해 상반기(6천만원)보다 300만원 늘었다. 이는 DS부문과 DX부문을 합친 수치다.)

Vice Chairman and CEO Jeon Young-hyun received 2.393 billion won in the first half of this year, while President Noh Tae-moon (acting head of the DX division) received 7.445 billion won in compensation. (전영현 삼성전자 대표이사 부회장은 올해 상반기 23억9300만원, 노태문 사장(DX부문장 직무대행)은 74억4500만원의 보수를 각각 받았다.)

Meanwhile, this semi-annual report also disclosed the number of minority shareholders for both companies. As of the end of June, Samsung Electronics had 7.971242 million minority shareholders, setting a record high. This is an increase of about 2.92 million from the end of June last year (5.049085 million). (한편, 이번 반기보고서에서는 두 회사의 소액주주 수도 공개됐다. 삼성전자의 지난 6월 말 기준 소액주주는 797만1242명으로, 역대 최대치를 기록했다. 지난해 6월 말(504만9085명)보다 약 292만명 늘었다.)

SK Hynix's minority shareholders also surged more than fivefold during the same period, from 681,671 to 3.461526 million, marking a record high. (에스케이하이닉스의 소액주주도 같은 기간 68만1671명에서 346만1526명으로 5배 넘게 늘어 역대 최대치를 기록했다.)
